Name: Choso Custom NPC Expanded Dialogue (EN and CN)
Author: RavenReed
Description:
[color=#ff00ff][size=5][i][b]【中文】[/b][/i][/size][/color]
你好，首先声明一下这个mod是我跟ai狂学三天三夜Modding制作出来的Mod，[b][color=#ff7700]存在ai辅助的内容[/color][/b][color=#ff7700]，[b]如果介意可不使用[/b][/color]，也有参考其他拓展对话mod代码结构的情况，在此致歉，因为本人无编码或Modding的基础和经验，所以在代码上逻辑上可能存在不合理，无法实现的情况，但可以确定的是现在SMAPI不会爆红或爆黄，工作之余做的
[b][color=#ff7700][size=4]【该mod仍在测试阶段】[/size][/color][/b]因为时间有限所以没有进行过完整测试，但确实可以运行。欢迎大家报告任何bug，我会进行排查与修正。但是与原mod本身存在的问题相关的bug可能会无能为力。

[b][color=#ffff00]目前只有中文与英文版本[/color][/b]，但是我的母语并不是英语，所以可能会翻译不好，如果你愿意检查英文翻译是否有误并制作正确的英文版本，可以直接修改i18n文件夹里的“[color=#00ffff]default.json[/color]”文件内内容。

为胀相增加约250+条可以使用的相关对话，当然，实际上很多句子可能因为条件有限无法触发或者随机不到

本mod理论上不会覆盖原NPCmod的dialogue，原mod原作者的句子依然可以在游戏中被随机到，但是我新加的dialogue可能会存在[color=#ff0000]OOC[/color]，[color=#ff0000]与原始mod人设与对话风格不符[/color]的情况，绝大多数dialogue可能也[color=#ff0000]不会是同人粉丝想要的效果[/color]，且[color=#ff0000]少数dialogue含有暗示性但不露骨的对话[/color]，请注意。
极少部分的“亲家反应”规则对话可能会覆盖游戏原始NPC的日常对话。

前置mod:
[color=#00ffff]Choso Custom NPC by OurpleKay，
SMAPI，
Content Patcher，
Custom Tokens[/color](建议有，虽然没有不影响运行，但是SMAPI会爆黄并且一些句子无法触发)

该mod文件名字虽然包含SVE，但是理论上没有SVE模组依然可以运行，也就是说，该mod理论上兼容胀相NPCmod的普通版与SVE版本，与SVE相关内容只有一些SVE角色的inlaw反应特定对话。

使用方法: 直接将压缩包解压至mod文件夹

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][i][b]【English】[/b][/i][/size][/color]
Hello, first off, I'd like to clarify that this mod was created with the help of AI after three days and nights of modding. [b][color=#ff7700]It contains AI-assisted content, so if you're uncomfortable with that, feel free to skip it.[/color][/b] Additionally, I've referenced the code structure of other dialogue expansion mods. My apologies for that. Since I have no background or experience in coding or modding, there may be logical inconsistencies or unimplementable aspects in the code. However, I can confirm that SMAPI currently shows no red or yellow warnings. This mod was developed during my free time. 
[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]【This mod is still in the testing phase】[/b][/size][/color] Due to time constraints, it hasn't undergone comprehensive testing, but it does function. Please report any bugs you encounter, and I will investigate and fix them. However, I may be unable to address bugs related to issues inherent to the original mod itself. 

[color=#ffff00]Currently, only Chinese and English versions are available.[/color] However, English is not my native language, so the translation may not be perfect. If you're willing to review the English translation for errors and create a correct English version, you can directly modify the content within the “[color=#00ffff]default.json[/color]” file located in the i18n folder.

Added approximately 250+ usable dialogue lines for Choso. Of course, many sentences may not trigger or be randomly selected due to limited conditions. 

This mod won't overwrite original NPC mod dialogues. Sentences from the original mod creator can still be randomly triggered in-game. However, my newly added dialogues may occasionally be [color=#ff0000]out of character (OOC)[/color], [color=#ff0000]potentially clashing with the original mod's character designs and conversational styles[/color]. Most of these dialogues likely [color=#ff0000]won't meet anime and doujin fans' expectations[/color], and [color=#ff0000]a small number contain suggestive yet non-explicit content[/color]. Please be aware. 

A very small number of "in-law reaction" rule-based dialogues may override the original NPC's daily conversations. 

Prerequisite mods:
[color=#00ffff]Choso Custom NPC by OurpleKay,
SMAPI,
Content Patcher,
Custom Tokens[/color] (recommended, though not required for operation; however, SMAPI will display yellow warnings and some lines of dialogue may fail to trigger) 

Although the mod filename includes "SVE," it should theoretically run without SVE mod. This means [color=#00ffff]it's compatible with both the standard and SVE versions of the Choso NPC mod[/color]. The only SVE-related content involves specific dialogue triggers for certain SVE characters. 

Usage: Simply extract the compressed file into your mod folder.

【中文详细介绍】
好的，以下，我将简单介绍这个mod的新增内容:

[list]
[*]更多的婚前日常通用对话(从2心开始，抽中新句子的概率理论上约为50%)增加约40句
[/list]
[list]
[*]更多的婚后通用对话，增加约100句(包含日常通用，NoBed反应，农场里出现怪物，嫉妒反应，kids相关等)
[/list]
[list]
[*]更多的节日通用对话和婚后的节日通用对话(从3心至婚前，对节日特殊对话进行覆盖，不同的好感度(3~5，6~8)和关系(约会，订婚)分别对应不同的对话，增加婚后节日通用对话，对于婚后节日通用对话，抽中新句子的概率理论约为67%)
[/list]
[list]
[*]星露谷部分原生NPC和部分SVE NPC对你和Choso婚姻的反应(需要和NPC好感度至少达到8心才能触发，在某个季节的某一天对话时出现这句话，可能会覆盖NPC角色的少数日常对话)
[/list]
[list]
[*]婚后阶段，新的通用接受礼物对话将替换原本的通用接受礼物对话，同时，婚后新增特定礼物特殊对话和特定生日礼物特殊对话
[/list]
[list]
[*][color=#00ffff]有custom tokens才能实现[/color](未测试): 结婚周年纪念日特殊对话，按婚龄阶段分别设置对话池(28天内，一年~两年，两年以后)(您可能需要不进行任何时间跳跃作弊，正常地度过游戏天数，才可能在正确的时间点看到这些特殊对话)
[/list]
【Detailed Description】 
Alright, below I'll briefly introduce the new additions in this mod: 

[list]
[*]More universal pre-marriage daily conversations (starting from 2 hearts, with a theoretical 50% chance of drawing new sentences) – approximately 40 additional lines 
[/list]
[list]
[*]More post-marriage common dialogues, adding about 100 lines (including daily interactions, NoBed reactions, monsters appearing on the farm, jealousy responses, kids-related topics, etc.) 
[/list]
[list]
[*]More festival-related general dialogues and post-marriage holiday dialogues (from 3 hearts to pre-marriage, covering special holiday dialogues. Different affection levels (3~5, 6~8) and relationship statuses (dating, engaged) correspond to different dialogues. Added post-marriage holiday dialogues, with a theoretical probability of approximately 67% for drawing new sentences). 
[/list][list]
[*]Reactions from certain native NPCs and SVE NPCs in Stardew Valley regarding your marriage to Choso (Requires at least 8 hearts of affection with the NPC to trigger; this line appears during dialogue on a specific day of a particular season and may override some of the NPC's daily conversations) 
[/list]
[list]
[*]Post-marriage phase: New universal gift acceptance dialogue replaces the original universal gift acceptance dialogue. Additionally, specific gift special dialogue and specific birthday gift special dialogue are added post-marriage. 
[/list]
[list]
[*][color=#00ffff]Requires custom tokens to implement[/color] (untested): Anniversary special dialogue, with separate dialogue pools based on marriage duration (within 28 days, 1–2 years, 2+ years)(You may need to avoid any time-jumping cheats and progress through the game's days normally to encounter these special dialogues at the correct time points.)
[/list]
